column1: # Flash layout for every ESP32-S3 board (minimum flash size 4 MB).
# FROZEN: updates over Bluetooth replace only the app
# bootloader. Any change here needs a USB flash on every device. Grow features
# into the spare room instead (app slots
#   0x01D000  otadata               8 KB  which app slot boots
#   0x01F000  phy_init              4 KB  optional PHY init data
#   0x020000  ota_0              1792 KB  app slot A (the firmware is ~0.6 MB)
#   0x400000  end of 4 MB; larger flash stays unused
# App slots start on 64 KB boundaries (MMU page size).
